items.message: No test covers `show-workflow <family>` (printing a whole module) or `show-workflow --registered`.

`assert one.output.strip() in inspect.getsource(implement)` is a substring test that would pass even if `show-workflow implement/report` printed any prefix of the module source; it does not uniquely assert that the correct function was isolated.

`_workflow_ids` uses a regex over `inspect.getsource(module.register)` to discover workflow IDs; no test covers the case where the regex matches zero IDs (e.g. if the `register` function's source format changes), which would silently cause `show-workflow <family>` to list no workflows and `show-workflow <id>` to always fail with a misleading error.
